verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a deprecation notice for one client SDK (recommending migration from google-search-results-python to serpapi-python), showing some lifecycle management, but no documented API versioning scheme, no changelog, and no formal deprecation policy for the core search APIs themselves; the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s for all candidate paths, suggesting no machine-readable versioned spec is published. missing for 10: documented API version numbers/scheme, an explicit deprecation policy document, changelog of breaking changes, and independent corroboration of long-term API stability commitments.
